metadata.chemistry_rationale: Five-envelope PDI-Me-COOH hypothesis including a pi-pi* satellite. The two aryl-methyl carbons are treated as unresolved within aromatic_C-C_C=C rather than forced into a mathematically redundant peak.
metadata.position_basis: Absolute uncalibrated guesses transferred from the homologous PDI-H-COOH model; the PDI-Me-COOH raw maximum is 284.500054 eV and sample-wide calibration is applied only after review.
